worldcombat.skill.pursuit.summary: Pounces on a target that is pulling away; the blow doubles when the target is retreating.
worldcombat.skill.pursuit.description.0: Pounces low along the chosen direction: %1$s physical damage; pounce range %2$s blocks, %3$s blocks per tick, collision radius %4$s blocks. Aim it freely at a direction or point and it may whiff; it only deals damage to the first enemy it runs into, stopping early at terrain or an ally. The power doubles when the target is moving away at the moment of impact.
Only pounce at a target within this distance; raise it to start from farther away, lower it to chase only in melee range.
